application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
decision_conditions: Given the current height of the tree's canopy and clearance from the house limb removal to improve daylight levels would be excessive and is, therefore, considered unjustified for the intended purpose. Additionally, in the absence of any written advice from a suitably qualified professional to demonstrate the necessity of works for the purposes of hazard management, there is also no justification for works on these grounds.Notwithstanding this, subject to a further application, modest reduction and/or thinning of the tree's crown may be accepted to manage its proportions relative to its location and improve daylight levels to the garden and rooms on the eastern side of the dwelling.
